scope: Actual CCID receive/execute with real applets. Shared literal packets, explicit USB packet boundaries and tick schedules. Covers E01/E02/E03/E04/E21/E23 subsets and newly audited first-header/error fields. No NFC/WebUSB, busy/IRQ races, PKE failure injection or physical hardware acceptance is inferred.
